method: The key was built from en.uesp.net (uesp_key.json) by an agent that saw only the names. The judge saw each person's two answers as X/Y in seeded random order, scored them against the key, then was told which was which; scores were not changed after.
summary: The reads got 18 of 20 right and 2 partly right; the placements got 3 right, 14 partly right and 3 wrong. Placements mostly named the right building but gave no role, sent you to the night spot instead of the day one (Ungrien, Aicantar, Vittoria, Thonnir), or gave nothing at all (Edda, Morven Stroud, Bujold). The reads' misses were Morven Stroud (his soul-husk trade left out) and Bujold (asleep in camp when she should be at the Beast Stone at night); their smaller slips were a few missed quests and roles (Fanari not called chief, Torsten called a merchant, Mjoll's follower condition). The placements never contradicted UESP; they only left things out.
